test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No onion is a lemon.

No lemon is a potato.

Conclusions:

I. No onion is a potato.

II. No potato is a lemon.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf80f3494d820ee3549d7a5faae1208fe00d910d550226ff93d03d20cec9e9a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No onion is a potato → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No potato is a lemon → True (as no lemon is a potato)

Hence, **only conclusion II follows.**
